symptom: A target project contained both .polaris/runtime and a bare runtime directory; the bare Run Ledger file continued changing during the exact L3-21 run.

dynamic_evidence.lowest_resolver_reproduction_before_fix: A temporary workspace with KERNELONE_RUNTIME_ROOT=<workspace>/runtime resolved runtime_mode=legacy_project_local_explicit, created the bare directory, and did not create .polaris/runtime.
dynamic_evidence.lowest_resolver_reproduction_after_fix: The same direct KernelOne call resolves runtime_mode=project_local_legacy_normalized to <workspace>/.polaris/runtime and leaves <workspace>/runtime absent.

root_causes: RunLedger and several runtime-path helpers directly constructed <workspace>/runtime instead of consuming storage.layout authority.

InstanceSupervisor copied the Launcher's environment into the child without overwriting workspace/runtime identity before Python imports, so bootstrap cached the parent authority despite correct child CLI args and registry metadata.

The lowest KernelOne write-capable resolver still accepted KERNELONE_RUNTIME_ROOT=<workspace>/runtime as legacy_project_local_explicit, so direct callers and stale inherited environments could bypass the Launcher/Backend normalization defenses.
fixes: Route Run Ledger, KernelOne storage helpers, QA signals, ContextOS metrics, receipt lookup, PM contract readers, and backend CLI defaults through canonical runtime resolution.
Route log enrichment, PM run-once traceability, and PM iteration snapshots through the same canonical runtime resolver.
Overwrite KERNELONE_WORKSPACE, KERNELONE_INSTANCE_WORKSPACE, KERNELONE_CONTEXT_ROOT, and KERNELONE_RUNTIME_ROOT in the child Popen environment; remove inherited KERNELONE_RUNTIME_CACHE_ROOT.
Normalize the retired <workspace>/runtime path inside KernelOne's lowest write-capable resolver and direct StorageLayout construction; retain it only in read-only discovery candidates.
Make the persisted-settings storage test restore all process environment mutations so temporary external runtime authority cannot leak into later tests.
Keep legacy bare-runtime readers read-only; never dual-write or auto-delete an active runtime.

verification.unit: 166 focused Storage Cell, KernelOne, integration, Backend, Run Ledger, and Instance Supervisor tests passed with 1 skip; the direct stale-env regression passed; ruff and mypy passed for changed runtime-path sources.
verification.live: Fresh isolated PID 68890 exposed the target workspace in /v2/runtime/fingerprint and all four target identity variables in /proc; after a QA-only retry the canonical ledger grew to 145221 bytes while the legacy ledger remained unchanged.

residual_risk: The physical legacy directory remains until explicit offline retention/cleanup. Its presence is not a writer or authority signal.
